If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is <0.33 in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to counter pessimism.  
If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is rising, cap upward momentum at +1.0% for late horizon (16–30 days) to prevent overshoot.  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is falling, avoid downward correction beyond -0.5% for late horizon to prevent panic-driven underestimation.  
If sentiment is >0.67 and true price exceeds forecast by >1.5%, adjust next forecast down by 0.5–1.0% to align with sentiment-driven momentum.  
If sentiment is <0.33 and true price is below forecast by >1.5%, adjust next forecast up by 0.5–1.0% to reflect sentiment-driven underreaction.
